profile.headline: Web Dev/DB Admin at Celerant Technology
profile.summary: Born in Puerto Rico and fully bilingual, I am now a grad student at Kennesaw State University, formerly Southern Polytechnic State University. I am continuing my education in Information Technology and I am planning on getting two certificates (Information Security and Data Analysis) throughout my grad career. I am currently searching for my first job in the IT field.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Roles (Web Developer, DB Admin, Interim Dept Manager, Web Support, PM):

Web Developer
-Create new features for our future website releases
-Work with the website developers to further improve our website templates 
-Help improve the data sync between the websites and our POS systems
-Created our very first Web Portal website backend to give our clients more power over their website and data
-Deploy new web servers and update/maintain our existing servers

Database Administrator
-Setup, update, and maintain 6 different database servers with over 600 databases
-Create and maintain SQL jobs 
-Create custom SQL procedures and reports to streamline our websites and web support
-Create and optimize existing database objects and queries

Interim Department Manager
-Manage the department as needed
-Work with priority clients to review and resolve issues
-Handle escalated issues and clients
-Communicate with other departments

Web Support
-Assist with any issues that any of our e-commerce clients run into
-Maintain open communication between all parties while the issues are being fixed
-On call during weekend and off hours to assist with high priority issues 
-Make changes to website files or the database as necessary to fix any issues 
-Maintain the ticket queue and escalate tickets when necessary 
-Work with and train my team on existing web issues

Web Implementation Manager
-Work with clients to start and finish their custom e-commerce website
-Train clients on how to work the website's front end and back end portals
-Assist the client with any pre-live or post-live issues
-Communicate client expectations to the website developers to achieve their desired end goal
-Work alongside other departments during the project cycle

positions.title: Software Support Engineer
positions.description:
Roles:
Entry Level Tech - 10 months
Level 2 Tech - 6
Mentor Tech - 3 months

Duties:
Answer phone calls and email inquiries from users and provide technical support/guidance to resolve incidents using IBM Lotus Notes.

Provide phone support and e-mail support for clients in need of technical assistance by troubleshooting issues for our retail software using remote technologies (RDP, VNC, TeamViewer, GoToMyPC, etc.), and SQL Management Studio.

Help clients solve network communication issues, killing and restarting ports, ensuring all services running properly, etc.

Use log files to determine when and where failures are happening and what type of information the software is trying to process.

Run SQL queries and procedures on database to summarize, correct and maintain data. 

Perform database backups on client’s servers, working with compression tools and FTP tools to transfer data to in-house servers. 

Gather information to create bugs using JIRA and replicate bugs for testing in order to determine root cause

•	​Support Implementation/Training Team with any customer issues.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant/Grader
positions.description: I help a few teachers during their lab classes; I help students program in Java and C#. I also tutor any students who needs help in those two language and I'll try to help with any other skills I have.

certifications.name: Masters of Science in Information Technology
certifications.title: Masters of Science in Information Technology

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: I was on the Dean's List four semesters in a row.

projects.title: IT Capstone Project
projects.description: Co-Team Leader for our IT Capstone group. My group and I had to revamp our client's website. Our client runs a survey website. We were in charge of adding new features to it like password recovery, dynamic questions, and multiple surveys per user. We used a combination of PHP, JavaScript,  Ajax, MySQL Server, and MySQL Workbench in order to get this done.

projects.title: Advance Web Development Website
projects.description: I had to completely code a website that uses the google books API. I used JSON, XML, PHP, JavaScript, Ajax, HTMl, and CSS to make it work. The website had to first display by favorited books from google books, then it had to actually search the google API for whatever the user input.
